events.verdict: Poeltl (SAS) makes contact to Adebayo's (MIA) arm after his gather and contact affects his driving shot attempt.
Murray (SAS) pins the ball to his body on his left foot and hops consecutively on the same foot.
Nunn (MIA) places his hand to Murray's (SAS) side moving alongside of his path to the basket and marginal contact occurs during his driving shot attempt.
Murray (SAS) initiates contact to Butler's (MIA) body during the screen and contact dislodges him from his position.
Iguodala (MIA) places his arm to DeRozan's (SAS) side during his drive and marginal contact occurs.
Adebayo (MIA) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Nunn (MIA) jumps along Poeltl's (SAS) path and marginal contact occurs during his shot attempt a the basket.
Poeltl (SAS) slides his hand against Adebayo's (MIA) backside during his drive to the basket and he is able to move through the contact.
Gay (SAS) places his arm to Butler's (MIA) side moving alongside of him during his drive and marginal contact occurs.
Ariza (MIA) and Poeltl (SAS) engage and disengage with one another for the loose ball.
Murray (SAS) initiates contact to Adebayo's (MIA) body and contact affects his shot attempt at the basket.
Ariza (MIA) briefly places his hand to DeRozan's (SAS) arm during his drive and quickly removes it.

Replay review of the foul called on Poeltl (SAS) pursuant to a coach?s challenge was deemed unsuccessful.  Poeltl makes contact with Butler's (MIA) lower body during his jump shot attempt and there is no clear and conclusive evidence to overturn the call on the floor.
Ariza (MIA) places a resting hand to Gay's (SAS) side during his upward shooting motion and removes it without applying force defending his jump shot attempt.
Poeltl (SAS) grasps Adebayo's (MIA) arm during rebounding and disengages as they pursue the loose ball.
